parts.text: A student is determining a quantity called the refractive index of the material of a transparent block. Fig. 4.1 shows the ray-tracing sheet that the student is producing. ABCD is the outline of the transparent block, drawn on the ray-tracing sheet. Fig. 4.1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) Draw the normal NN' to side AB , extended to cross side DC , so that the normal is 2.0 cm from A . Label the point F where NN' crosses AB . Label the point G where NN' crosses DC .

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Draw the line EF at an angle of 30° to the normal and to the left of the normal NN' . E is a point outside the block and above AB on the ray-tracing sheet. [3]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Read the following passage, taken from the student’s notebook and then answer the questions that follow. I placed two pins P 1 and P 2 on line EF . I observed the images of P 1 and P 2 through side CD of the block so that the images of P 1 and P 2 appeared one behind the other. I placed two more pins P 3 and P 4 between my eye and the block so that P 3 , P 4 and the images of P 1 and P 2 , seen through the block, appeared one behind the other. I marked the positions of P 1 , P 2 , P 3 and P 4 .

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Draw a line joining the positions of P 3 and P 4 . Continue the line until it meets CD . Label this point H .

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Measure and record the length a of the line GH . a = ......................................................

ms.label: 4(b)(ii)
ms.text: a and b both with appropriate unit

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Measure and record the length b of the line HF . b = ..................................................[3]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Extend the straight line EF through the outline of the block to a point J . The point J must be at least 5 cm from the block. The line EJ crosses the line CD . Label this point K .

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Measure and record the length c of the line GK . c = ......................................................

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Measure and record the length d of the line FK . d = ......................................................

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate the refractive index n of the material of the block using the equation n = cb ad . n = ..................................................[3]
